Package com.csse3200.game.components.player

Class TimedPlayerAbility

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.player.PlayerAbility
com.csse3200.game.components.player.TimedPlayerAbility
Direct Known Subclasses:
Invisibility, LastStand
public abstract class TimedPlayerAbility extends PlayerAbility
An ability whose whole run is one timed condition on the player. Each start creates a fresh condition and hands it to the player's status effects controller, which owns the countdown, and every question about whether the ability is running is answered from that.

Subclasses supply how to make the condition and say what makes the ability start: a cast ability overrides PlayerAbility.isCastable(), a passive overrides PlayerAbility.triggersOnDamage(com.csse3200.game.components.CombatStatsComponent, com.csse3200.game.entities.Entity, int, int). Neither has to repeat the wiring. An ability that finishes the moment it starts, or that acts on somebody other than the player, extends PlayerAbility directly instead and never touches this.

      name - name carried by the abilityUsed, abilityEnded and abilityFailed events
